# Threat intelligence and adversaries

> Who attacks, with what, and how: intelligence practice, threat reporting, groups, malware, incidents, and OSINT.

Part of the [domain hubs](/hubs/README.md). 7 reference documents in this domain; reading time is the page's words at 230 words a minute.

## References

| Reference | What it covers | Reading time |
|---|---|---|
| [Threat Intelligence Reference](/THREAT_INTELLIGENCE_REFERENCE.md) | Intel lifecycle, STIX/TAXII, threat actor profiles, IOC enrichment, TIP platforms, and intelligence-driven detection | 25 min |
| [Threat Report Almanac](/THREAT_REPORT_ALMANAC.md) | Annotated index of the 15 major annual threat reports (DBIR, M-Trends, CrowdStrike GTR, MDDR, X-Force, ENISA, IC3, Dragos, etc.) organized by methodology basis, with a critical-reading method and a quarterly reading calendar | 17 min |
| [Threat Actors](/THREAT_ACTORS.md) | Nation-state APTs, ransomware groups, and eCrime actors mapped to ATT&CK TTPs | 9 min |
| [Threat Group Profiles](/THREAT_GROUP_PROFILES.md) | Adversary groups in ATT&CK v20.0 with observed technique usage (174 of 178), with aliases, attributed techniques, and tooling (STIX-derived) | 31 min |
| [Malware Families](/MALWARE_FAMILIES.md) | Ransomware, banking trojans, RATs, APT malware, rootkits, and loaders with TTPs and analysis resources | Lookup page (25 min end to end) |
| [Notable Incidents](/NOTABLE_INCIDENTS.md) | Curated reference of significant cyber incidents, nation-state campaigns, ransomware events, and critical vulnerabilities | 27 min |
| [OSINT Reference](/OSINT_REFERENCE.md) | Passive recon, OSINT frameworks, Maltego, Shodan/Censys/FOFA, social media OSINT, domain/IP investigation | 16 min |
